scientific_integrity: Classical Cauchy--Davenport and Vosper in conjunction with a fully derived quadratic-character triple count; finite exhaustive tests are corroboration, not proof.
scientific_limitations: Prime fields only, with strict majority; optimal fourfold only uniformly over primes >=13, not claimed at every prime; hidden equivalent prior work remains possible.
title: Fourfold covering by majority quadratic residues and the two exceptional prime fields
